configurePresets.name: server
configurePresets.description: Builds sft_server with SQLite+Argon2+OpenSSL TLS 1.3. Generates certs if missing, creates storage/. Run on server laptop only.

configurePresets.name: client
configurePresets.description: Builds sft_client with Asio TLS. Expects server IP via --server. No DB, no Argon2 link needed beyond sft_app.

configurePresets.name: ci-loopback
configurePresets.displayName: CI Loopback (one laptop, ephemeral, simulated if no OpenSSL)
configurePresets.description: For ctest on single machine. Uses ephemeral ports, Falls back to simulated TLS if OpenSSL not found.
